subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech.

I told him that I was busy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** I told him that I was busy.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **“I told him that I was busy” becomes “I told him, ‘I am busy.’”**
 
 
• Pronoun “I” remains unchanged as the speaker is referring to themselves.
 
• Verb “was” is converted to “am” to reflect the present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: “I told him”
 
• Converted to: “I told him,” maintaining the context of the conversation.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter “I” and ends with a period “.”
 
• Reporting clause precedes the quoted speech, followed by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“I told him, ‘I am busy.’”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** “I told him, ‘You are busy.’”
 
 
• Changes the subject from “I” to “You,” altering the meaning of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** “Said, ‘I am busy.’”
 
 
• Incomplete reporting clause: missing the subject and context.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “I told him, ‘I was busy.’”
 
 
• Incorrect tense: “was” should be changed to “am” to reflect direct speech.
